_comment: OPTIONAL, GLOBAL hard network allow-list. Installed by `sudo ./install.sh --managed-allowlist` to the OS managed-settings path (macOS: /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json). Because it is a MANAGED setting it enforces an allow-list-only egress policy that user/launcher --settings cannot express. WARNING: managed settings apply to EVERY claude session on this machine (plain `claude` and base `claudex` too), not just `claudex --strict`. Edit allowedDomains to taste before installing.
